column1: # The declared graph of the build (DOC-0224 §13). One line per product pattern under Resources/Essenthos/, no extension:
#   {name} is one path segment bound across the line, * one segment, ** any depth; the first line that matches a product is its line.
# maker: hand (people edit it), export (written from a database once; re-run at cut-over), build (forge build runs the producer).
# producer: the Forge verb and arguments the build runs, once per distinct producer, in the order the inputs ask for.
# inputs: what the product may read, as patterns under Resources/; {sources} is the text's declared sources in the catalogue.
#   A product whose header names an input no pattern of its line covers fails the build.
# tables: the serving tables it feeds (@records: every table records-load writes); scope: what build --apply replaces when it moves.
